title: Gegagedigedagedago
blurb: Gegagedigedagedago began life as a gibberish Cotton Eye Joe cover, met a Roblox chicken-nugget animation, and mutated into an entire subgenre, complete with its own visual language and several thousand remixes. It runs the same trick as most great brainrot: a string of syllables carrying no meaning whatsoever, delivered rhythmically enough that your brain files it as a real word anyway. Nobody can spell it. Everybody can say it. Play it to instantly identify who in the room is under sixteen.
origin: A gibberish Cotton Eye Joe cover fused with a Roblox chicken-nugget animation into a viral nonsense chant.
